procurement.label: For procurement
procurement.reader: A contracting officer who buys an AI system or service
procurement.document: OMB Memorandum M-25-22, Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government
procurement.passage: Resulting performance-based requirements allow agencies to understand and assess vendor claims about their proposed use of AI systems or services prior to contract award.

impact-assessment.label: For impact assessment
impact-assessment.reader: The federal program owner who assesses a high-impact use of AI
impact-assessment.document: OMB Memorandum M-25-21, Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust
impact-assessment.section: Section 4(b)(ii), items A, E and F
impact-assessment.passage: the intended purpose for the AI and its expected benefit, supported by specific metrics or qualitative analysis, assessing impact inclusive of but not limited to costs, customer experience, or expected positive outcomes of AI use, as compared to existing agency processes

clinical-use.label: For clinical use
clinical-use.reader: A hospital's chief medical information officer
clinical-use.document: The Joint Commission and the Coalition for Health AI, Guidance on the Responsible Use of AI in Healthcare (RUAIH)
clinical-use.passage: During procurement, healthcare organizations should request information from developers/vendors on how AI tools were tested and validated for their intended use, whether they are willing to tune and/or validate a sample that is representative of the deployment context, and how relevant biases were evaluated.
columns: how it was tested and validated

regulation.label: For regulation
regulation.reader: The European Commission and its AI Office, when they weigh a change to Annex III
regulation.passage: the magnitude and likelihood of benefit of the deployment of the AI system for individuals, groups, or society at large, including possible improvements in product safety
regulation.note: The database grades how strongly its sources show that a benefit happened. That grade is the nearest field to the likelihood of benefit, and it is not the same thing. The database has no field for product safety, so the sector stands in for it.
columns: for individuals, groups, or society at large

court-use.label: For court use
court-use.reader: Judges, court administrators and court staff
court-use.document: UNESCO, Guidelines for the Use of AI Systems in Courts and Tribunals
court-use.passage: Before adopting AI systems, the judiciary should assess both the specific potential benefits (for the judiciary, users, and the public) and its institutional capacity to realise these benefits.
court-use.scope: the benefits in the justice system
columns: how the system's work was checked
what must hold for it to happen again
